change: World-space opacity masks replace angular blocker-distance interpolation. Two-dimensional filtering creates soft cover contours; static world-space edge variation prevents camera-swimming noise.
notes: The previous implementation interpolated hit distances and projected stale profiles from the live observer, creating long swept wedges at cover corners.
History now blends opacity at fixed world coordinates; only the current circular range follows the observer.
CPU measurements exclude capture encoding and other scene work; actual phone performance remains unmeasured.
Known sandbox environment diagnostics remain for root certificate store, GD-Sync user config writes and rendering cache writes.

temporal_render_comparison.interpretation: Same route and static ground ROI; describes rendered motion variation, not gameplay visibility correctness.
